item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Higher limit of Azure Blob Storage accounts per region per subscription
item.description:
Azure Blob Storage account quotas are now generally available at up to 1,000 standard-endpoint storage accounts per region per subscription, increased from the default 250. This allows more storage accounts to be managed within a single subscription.

  • Source: Azure Updates
